Krishna

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] CmdStan Make Error on Windows

If that doesn't do it, can you edit make/os_win? It should have a -m64 sitting there somewhere and you can remove that. 


Daniel

THAT DID IT. The trick was to make sure all the RTools bin directories are at the beginning of the Windows path. Just in case anyone faces similar issues here are some details:

- OS: Win7
- CmdStan2.12.0 installed from the .zip file. If installing by cloning from github, follow these instructions: https://github.com/stan-dev/cmdstan/wiki/Getting-Started-with-CmdStan
- RTools: version 3.3 
Make sure that once RTools has finished installation, the following are in the PATH environment variable, c:\Rtools\mingw_64\bin;c:\Rtools\gcc-4.6.3\bin;c:\Rtools\bin; and more importantly it's in the beginning of the PATH (thanks Daniel)

Thanks Daniel for the prompt responses. 

- Kedar
